description: Screenshot of a tweet by Techno Fog (@Techno_Fog), dated April 10 2020, about the declassification of DOJ Inspector General report footnotes. The tweet claims the Crossfire Hurricane team had multiple reports disputing material claims of Christopher Steele's dossier and warning of 'disinformation', with a hat tip to @CBS_Herridge. Attached is a photograph of a heavily redacted, highlighted and hand-annotated declassified footnote (footnote 350) discussing potential Russian disinformation influencing Steele's election reporting.
text: Techno Fog. @Techno_Fog. Following. Declassification of IG Report footnotes. Crossfire Hurricane Team had multiple reports disputing many material claims of Steele and his dossier - and warning of "disinformation". HT @CBS_Herridge. 350 In addition to the information in Steele's Delta file documenting Steele's frequent contacts with representatives for multiple Russian oligarchs, we identified reporting the Crossfire Hurricane team received from [redacted] indicating the potential for Russian disinformation influencing Steele's election reporting. A [redacted] 2017, report relayed information from [redacted] outlining an inaccuracy in a limited subset of Steele's reporting about the activities of Michael Cohen. The [redacted] stated that it did not have high confidence in this subset of Steele's reporting and assessed that the referenced subset was part of a Russian disinformation campaign to denigrate U.S. foreign relations. A second report from the same [redacted] five days later stated that a person named in the limited subset of Steele's reporting had denied representations in the reporting and the [redacted] assessed that the person's denials were truthful. A [redacted] report dated [redacted] 2017, contained information about an individual with reported connections to Trump and Russia who claimed that the public reporting about the details of Trump's [redacted] activities in Moscow during a trip in 2013 were false, and that they were the product of RIS "infiltrat[ing] a source into the network" of a [redacted] who compiled a dossier of information on Trump's activities. The [redacted] noted that it had no information indicating that the individual had special access to RIS activities or information. "assessed". "Russian disinformation campaign". 197. 12:45 PM - 10 Apr 2020.
flags: Document text is heavily redacted; bracketed [redacted] markers stand in for blacked-out portions
Tweet's characterization of the footnotes is the poster's claim

description: Screenshot of a tweet by The Trump Train (@The_Trump_Train), shown as retweeted by Donald J. Trump, posting a photoshopped meme of Obama-era officials and Democratic figures behind prison bars. The meme text asks when 'trials for treason' will begin now that 'Russia collusion is a proven lie.' Recognizable composited faces include Robert Mueller, John Podesta, Rod Rosenstein, Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, Huma Abedin, James Clapper, Eric Holder, Bill Clinton and Loretta Lynch.
text: Donald J. Trump Retweeted. The Trump Train [train emoji][US flag emoji] @The_Trump_Train . 6h. NOW THAT RUSSIA COLLUSION IS A PROVEN LIE, WHEN DO THE TRIALS FOR TREASON BEGIN? 209. 875. 2.4K.
flags: Meme asserts 'Russia collusion is a proven lie' and implies treason by those pictured — unverified political claim, not fact
Image is a photoshopped composite, not a real photograph of the individuals in jail
One or two background figures in the composite are not confidently identified

description: White Punisher skull logo centered on a solid black background, in tall phone-wallpaper proportions. The elongated-skull emblem originates with the Marvel Comics character The Punisher and was frequently posted in Q drops as a signal image.

Meme-style infographic titled 'The Democrat Party & Mainstream Media' pairing nine sets of Democratic administration officials with media figures and labeling the family relationship between each pair (married, brothers, mother & daughter). It presents these ties as evidence the party and press are 'one big happy family.' The named pairings include Susan Rice/Ian Cameron, Ben Rhodes/David Rhodes, Liz Sherwood/Ben Sherwood, Tom Nides/Virginia Moseley, Jay Carney/Claire Shipman, Katie Hogan/Matthew Jaffe, Valerie Jarrett/Laura Jarrett, Jim Sciutto/Gloria Riviera, and Andrew Cuomo/Chris Cuomo.

description: Dark-mode screenshot from a Q drop aggregator showing drop #694, titled 'Disease/Cancer Cures Exist', posted under tripcode !UW.yye1fxo on 7 Feb 2018. The drop insinuates that cures for diseases such as cancer already exist and questions the billions spent on cure development; the word 'cures' is highlighted in red by the aggregator's search.
text: 694. Disease/Cancer Cures Exist. Q !UW.yye1fxo 7 Feb 2018 - 9:06:12 PM. What if cures already exist? What about the billions (public/private/govt) provided to fund cure dev? Sheep. These people are sick! Q.
flags: The drop's suggestion that disease/cancer cures already exist and are suppressed is an unverified conspiracy claim
